summary: P01 V2.47.236 improves Navigation category selection UX for large taxonomies. Frontstage parent-category choice and Start-surface pending/bulk Navigation category choices use bounded searchable pickers instead of browser-native ultra-long dropdowns while keeping the native select as canonical form state. The Owner category rail keeps canonical ordering but presents the first 10 root categories plus the active branch, with explicit 更多分类 / 收起分类 and full search override. category_save parent_id semantics, category_reorder, Schema/Data authority, lifecycle, auth/session/security semantics and updater mechanism are unchanged. Production remains Owner-manual.
